g.text: Where the city lives, where the observatory listens
Hexagons: people per H3 cell (res 8, ~0.74 km2), darker = more people; about 1.72 million people in the window. Rings: the 116 instruments.
Kontur Population 2022 (CC BY 4.0) - a modelled estimate (built-up area x census), not a count.
